name: A dead Shadowhound leaves a corpse for the hunter pet corpse time (#1450)
contract: A Witch Hunter's Shadowhound 50124 vanished the moment it died. Like a hunter pet, its corpse now stays for the
pet corpse time (60 seconds, the creature default that every pet keeps) and Call From The Shadows 578118 can
revive it in place. A corpse left alone is then removed and saved dead, so the Whistle 801343 still refuses it
(SPELL_FAILED_DONT_REPORT 27) and Call From The Shadows still brings it back. Expected: 50 seconds after death
the corpse is still there at 0 health; it is gone within the next 15 seconds; the Whistle then fails with 27
and Call From The Shadows returns a living Shadowhound.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The hound settles beside the Witch Hunter
The Witch Hunter can take the blast
The hound is down to 1 health
The golem's blast hits the hound
Most of the corpse time passes
The corpse is still there after 50 seconds
The corpse is removed when the corpse time ends
The Whistle still refuses the dead hound
Call From The Shadows brings the hound back
